The boundary between the subject and background is soft, which is partly due to depth-of-field but also characteristic of AI diffusion models struggling with fine hair edges. I will adjust the artifact score slightly downward to account for this structural ambiguity, though it is not catastrophic.
alignment_reasoning: The `fine_grained_classifier` strongly confirms the class (Logit 7.72 vs 2.85 for next best). Visually, the face, eyes, and fur texture are highly consistent with an orangutan.
